Name: Hearth and Home - Kitchen (CP)
Author: hypnagogie
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/59cPwMum.png[/img]﻿[/center]
This is a cozy modern farmhouse kitchen retexture for my Hearth & Home collection, with several customizable options.

[list]
[*]5 cabinet/shelf colors 
[*]2 counter types
[*]6 stove colors (that coincidentally coordinate with the kitchen mixers & dutch ovens in the furniture mod)
[*]3 types of metal fixtures
[/list]﻿
Fun fact - "Amboine" is a French wood that I found using a reverse google image search after I accidentally made a beautiful wood texture that I fell in love with and couldn't matchto any real-world wood that I knew of.  Maybe I remembered it from a past life.

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Download & install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod!
[*]﻿Unzip and move both Content Patcher and Hearth & Home - Kitchen to your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]Stardew Valley Mods folder[/url]
[*]Run the game
[/list]
[b]Configuration
[/b]
There are two ways to configure the kitchen options:

﻿1. After running the game with the mod installed, it will generate a file, config.json.  Edit that file using included instructions.

[center]OR[/center]

﻿2. Download & install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.  With this you can make changes while in the game and try different combinations!
